content: “How can jaguars and antelopes can work harmoniously together? – a public debate.” Or, with less humor, “How can capital and workers could work harmoniously together, for a better world? — a public debate.”

A cool initiative, though I worry that the title prescribes a specific outcome/opinion.
How about "live together in harmony" (:drop::earth_africa::fire::windy:), rather than "working together"?

I agree with the sentiment I see in Antoine’s comment. It is not for AI companies and mathematicians to both work towards a common goal. AI companies serve mathematicians’ needs and conform to math community norms. Full stop.
2 messages were moved here from #Event announcements > Public debate on AI companies and formalization by Riccardo Brasca.
A message was moved here from #general > The role of AI companies in large formalisation projects by Snir Broshi.

I am not as tyrannical as that. AI companies have every right to pursue every goal they wish. However, would they not conform to math community norms and ethical rules, I would feel natural that they be banned from participating to the activities of the mathematical community.

I am not sure that I understood every single problem with the Math Inc. action in the sphere packing project, hence I will not make an formal complaint, but propose an analogy. If somebody sets up a PR that gives the first steps to the formalization of some theorem that I find interesting, it could be natural to propose a cooperation, but finishing the work during the next weekend would be extremely unprofessional. As a matter of fact, this happens sometimes in (paper) math, and this always makes the younger people move away, and that is very regrettable.
It is not tyrannical to set hard boundaries and standards for working with the mathematical community and reject the work of AI companies that violate norms
We shouldn’t be bending over backwards or meeting them in the middle on these issues. Thy can cooperate or be excluded.
Is there any indication on when the recording of the debate will be available?
